Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 18 Landscaping and Open Spaces

Clause 2.18 - other (environmental_protection): Any new development must preserve and protect any existing trees on site.

Clause 2.18.1 - other (environmental_protection): To minimise the extent of hard paved areas and facilitate rainwater infiltration.

Clause 2.18.1 - other (development_control): To encourage green roofs and green walls particularly for large scale developments.

Clause 2.18.3 - other (development_control): A landscape plan and maintenance schedule must be submitted with any development application for residential, commercial and industrial development that requires landscaping.

Clause 2.18.3 - other (development_control): d. Use of mulch or similar treatments of garden beds with mulch depth not less than 100mm

Clause 2.18.3 - other (development_control): xiv. Any court walls facing a communal area or public place or road (that must be constructed of a material similar in type and colour to that used for the development found on site); and
